title: Continuous compactly supported complex functions are integrable
statement: Use $\mathbf R,\mathbf C$ [def-weil-field] with their usual Euclidean structures. Let $m\geq1$ and $h:\mathbf R^m\to\mathbf C$ be continuous. If $\overline{\{x:h(x)\ne0\}}$ is compact, then $h$ is Lebesgue integrable: $$\int_{\mathbf R^m}|h(x)|\,dx<\infty.$$ The support may be empty.
